serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
My heart is racing and I can feel my blood boiling inside me…
I bet everything on one card, I hope I didn’t make a mistake.
If Little Richard’s plan fails, I’m dead…
I want to frantically look around to see if DAK is following me, but I know if I do this he might find out I’m leading him to a trap.
I took walks many times through this area, but this is the first time I can feel every rock and crack through the sole of my shoes.
My senses feel sharpened, yet at the same time my head is spinning like I’m about to lose consciousness…
Is this how a cornered animal is feeling before a predator makes its final pounce? 
I’m doing my all to clear my mind, but all these thoughts come rushing through my head like a wild river.
Little Richard! I beg you! Don’t miss!
Now I realized that all my concerns about DAK’s life are gone…
It was a different thing when I was safe at home, but when it came to actually putting my life on the line, I want that motherfucker to drop dead!
It’s kind of pathetic that all my morality was replaced by animal-like survival instinct as soon as adrenaline was released into my brain, I guess that’s also a part of human nature…
I’m getting close to the place where the trap was set up.
